fight: Futures Rewritten (Ultimate), White Mage. Only casts by enemies you can target are listed, because the radar reads your target's cast bar; the rest are in the notes.

Cyclonic Break.say: Proteans, then pairs if fire, spread if lightning.
Cyclonic Break.note: P1. The fire and lightning versions share this name.

Powder Mark Trail.say: Tank buster, stay clear. Shield the tank.
Powder Mark Trail.note: P1. Splashes anyone near the tank and leaves Burn Mark, so the tanks swap. Divine Benison and Aquaveil on the tank.

Utopian Sky.say: Find the safe lines. Fire stacks, lightning spreads.
Utopian Sky.note: P1. Fatebreaker leaves and three clones mark Blasting Zone lines; the two unmarked directions are safe. Fire: light-party stacks. Lightning: spread. The clones then repeat Cyclonic Break and Burnt Strike, which can't be read.

Burnished Glory.say: Raidwide and bleed. Mitigate, then Medica 3.
Burnished Glory.note: P1. Regens and Asylum cover the bleed. The P1 enrage has the same name.

Fall of Faith.say: Four tethers. Fire stacks, lightning spreads.
Fall of Faith.note: P1. Tethers go out one at a time and lift their target. Fire: stack with that player's group. Lightning: spread for the cones. Line up in your strat's order.

Burnt Strike.say: Line cleave, then knockback if fire, out if lightning.
Burnt Strike.note: P1. At the end of P1, towers follow: everyone but the tanks soaks one, and with the fire version you get knocked back into it.

Quadruple Slap.say: Tank buster. Esuna the tank after the first hit.
Quadruple Slap.note: P2. Two hits on the same tank. The first can leave a cleansable debuff (a Bard's Warden's Paean prevents it); cleanse it before the second. Divine Benison and Aquaveil help too.

Diamond Dust.say: Big raidwide. Then axe kick out, scythe kick in.
Diamond Dust.note: P2. The boss leaves and Oracle's Reflection casts the kick, so it can't be read. Then protean baits or Frigid Stone puddles, the Heavenly Strike knockback, and Sinbound Holy: healers are the stack targets, so keep moving with your group. Shining Armor: look away. Then front and back sword cleaves.

Hallowed Ray.note: P2. A shared laser; everyone stands in the line.

Mirror, Mirror.note: P2. Scythe Kick and protean baits at the boss and the blue mirror, then again from the red mirrors. Banish III after: partner stacks or spread (no cast bar).

Scythe Kick.note: P2 Mirror, Mirror. The Diamond Dust kicks come from the Reflection and can't be read.

Light Rampant.say: Raidwide. Chains and puddles, then towers.
Light Rampant.note: P2. Tethered players spread into a ring without breaking the chains; two marked players drop Luminous Hammer puddles. With exactly 2 Lightsteep stacks take the middle tower, otherwise avoid it, and never take a fifth stack. Powerful Light orbs are stacks. Banish III partners or spread at the end.

The House of Light.note: End of P2, and P4. One hit each.

Absolute Zero.say: Big raidwide. Mitigate and heal up.
Absolute Zero.note: End of P2: a knockback (Swelling Frost) and the intermission adds follow. Also part of the P4 enrage, with Memory's End.

Endless Ice Age.say: Kill crystals, then Ice Veil. Raidwide after.
Endless Ice Age.note: Intermission. Ice Veil's enrage cast, interrupted once Ice Veil is under 50% HP. Crystals of Light drop puddles and Crystals of Darkness cleave. When Ice Veil dies, Junction hits everyone (can't be read), so heal up before Hell's Judgment.

Hell's Judgment.say: HP to 1. Heal everyone to full.
Hell's Judgment.note: P3. Ultimate Relativity's raidwide lands about 14 seconds later: Medica III, Afflatus Rapture, Cure III, Assize, Asylum, Plenary Indulgence.

Ultimate Relativity.say: Big raidwide. Then check your fire or ice timer.
Ultimate Relativity.note: P3. Fire debuffs are short, medium or long; one player gets ice. Follow your strat's spots: drop Rewind, bait stoplights, and look away from Shadoweye when Return pulls you back.

Shell Crusher.note: P3, after Ultimate Relativity. Shockwave Pulsar follows.

Black Halo.say: Shared tank cleave. Stay away, shield the tanks.
Black Halo.note: P3. Both tanks share it; everyone else avoids it.

Spell-in-Waiting: Refrain.say: Apocalypse next. Note your stack timer.
Spell-in-Waiting: Refrain.note: P3. Six players get Dark Water stacks (short, medium, long); two get none.

Apocalypse.say: Stacks, then spread. Follow the light rotation.
Apocalypse.note: P3. Spirit Taker spread, Dark Eruption spreads in the safe spots, second stacks, Darkest Dance, third stacks, then Shockwave Pulsar.

Spirit Taker.note: P3 Apocalypse and P4 Darklit Dragonsong. The one in Crystallize Time can't be read: cleanse first if you're still blue.

Darkest Dance.say: Tank bait, then knockback into stacks.
Darkest Dance.note: P3 Apocalypse. A tank baits the jump; everyone else is knocked back, then stacks.

Memory's End.note: End of P3. Also the P4 enrage, with Absolute Zero.

Materialization.say: Stack, then dodge Akh Rhai. Raidwide after.
Materialization.note: P4. Drachen Armor, then Akh Rhai puddles: keep moving. The Edge of Oblivion raidwide comes from an actor you can't target.

Darklit Dragonsong.say: Big raidwide. Tethers take towers, others bait cones.
Darklit Dragonsong.note: P4. Usual strat: tethered players soak the tower and the rest bait the cleaves. Then Spirit Taker spread, Hallowed Wings and stacks, Somber Dance, and Edge of Oblivion (raidwide).

Hallowed Wings.say: Half-room cleave. Safe side, then stacks.
Hallowed Wings.note: P4 Darklit Dragonsong. The ones at the end of Crystallize Time can't be read.

Somber Dance.say: Tank busters, far then close. Shield the tanks.
Somber Dance.note: P4. The first hit takes the farthest player, the second the closest; non-tanks stay in between.

Akh Morn.say: Group stacks, several hits. Heal through.
Akh Morn.note: P4 (five hits) and P5. A good spot for Liturgy of the Bell, Temperance or Medica III if your plan has them free.

Crystallize Time.say: Big raidwide. Then check red or blue.
Crystallize Time.note: P4. Red players pop dragon heads; blue players cleanse in the puddles after the stacks. Drop Rewind where your strat says, then Quietus (raidwide), Spirit Taker spread and Hallowed Wings.

Fulgent Blade.say: Raidwide, then rotating lines. Move into the gaps.
Fulgent Blade.note: P5. The Path of Light and Darkness lines sweep clockwise or counterclockwise. Akh Morn stacks follow.

Paradise Regained.say: Towers and wing cleaves. Party in or out with the tether.
Paradise Regained.note: P5. Three towers in a row while Wings Dark and Light cleaves one side, then the other, and a tether hits close or far. In most strats the tanks handle the towers, cleaves and tethers; keep them shielded.

Polarizing Strikes.say: Line stacks. Swap when you get hit.
Polarizing Strikes.note: P5. Four sets of line stacks; anyone hit picks up a debuff and swaps out. A follow-up hits after each set.

Pandora's Box.say: Tank limit break. Then heal everyone up.
